about: Made by tools/art-import/import_art.py. Do not edit by hand; re-run the script.
frameFormat: [page, x, y, w, h, trimX, trimY, fullW, fullH]

inside-main-floor.note: ONE wide scrolling room. Draw order: floor, walls, props, then wall-decal sprites and y-sorted sprites and characters sorted by sortRow, then foreground ABOVE the characters. floor: ground: lobby tile, blue mats, big red square with the school logo, thresholds, front-door mat, the seating decks and steps, the red gear-bag box base. Draw first, at depth 0. | walls: the north wall with its wall art, the side wall strips, the back-wall drywall. Nothing above the drywall. Draw above floor. | props: wall-hugging furniture that never moves: the creed boards, flag, mural frames, the gear shelf and crash mats. Under every character. | foreground: the front wall (curb, door posts, door header, open door leaves): the one FULL-FRAME layer drawn ABOVE characters, so a student walking in or out passes behind it. The seat backs and the bag tops are foreground SPRITES (see foregroundSprites), because each has its own sortRow.

wing-west.note: pro-shop alcove wall (the left wing). Hides the mat when a character is NORTH of it, is hidden by characters SOUTH of it.

wing-east.note: east wing wall that carries the two cross doors and the handprint wall (their sprites go on top of it).

pro-counter.note: pro shop counter in the left alcove (its back is the wing wall).

bag-red.note: heavy bag, branded red (DECIDE item, see README).

gear-box.note: the red gear-bag box with a 2.6-tile gap at each end onto the mat. Openings face the lobby (south).

seats.note: parent stadium seating, 3 tiers of 8 seats facing the mat, with the end steps. One sprite so the tiers never fight over depth.

bench.note: waiting bench against the lobby's west side.

target-wall.note: yellow target wall on the north wall (logo art + styles mural frame). Wall decal: draw it above its wall and below every character.

back-doors.note: double back doors in the north wall (to the back room). Wall decal: draw it above its wall and below every character.

cross-door-a.note: cross door A on the east wing (its shut face is on the lobby side). Wall decal: draw it above its wall and below every character.

cross-door-b.note: cross door B on the east wing. Wall decal: draw it above its wall and below every character.

handprint-wall.note: handprint wall between the two cross doors: plain handprints, NO names. Wall decal: draw it above its wall and below every character.

seats-back.foregroundRule: draw this sprite ABOVE a character only when the character's footprint (feet) row < sortRow; otherwise leave it out (the base sprite is already under the character)
seats-back.note: the 24 seat backs (backs and their inset panels) of the parent seating. Foreground sprite: an identical copy of pixels already in 'seats' (draw the base y-sorted as usual, then this one above the characters that are north of it).
